name: Harvest Gathering
rationale: A deep plum-walnut foundation separates cream tableware and golden candlelight from cranberry accents. The window, orchard, runner, place settings, bread, pie, candles, and pumpkins remain legible at gallery-card size while the upper middle stays calm behind course surfaces.
motionNotes: Five leaves drift only behind the window, three flames flicker independently, three steam curls rise at low opacity, and a pie slice lifts gently for one occasional cozy reveal. No motion uses noise, flashing, or abrupt full-screen changes.
